from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """One university's data from a Common Data Set submission."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The university's name")
    total_class_sections: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate class sections (from Section I-3)")
    large_class_sections_100plus: int | None = Field(description="Sections with 100 or more students (from Section I-3)")
    bachelor_degrees: int | None = Field(description="Bachelor's degrees awarded (from Section B3)")
    degree_period: str | None = Field(description="The period for degree data (e.g., 'July 2020 - June 2021')")
    institution_type: str | None = Field(description="Public or Private if specified (from Section A2)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
